svg.title: 3D-tight — Takeoff elbow with easy-bend elbow
svg.desc: Individual fitting. Upstream main duct is wider on its far/back side and reduces toward the existing takeoff, following the user's third markup. Retained the upstream joint location and extended its top seam across the wider duct; the reduction begins at this joint. Elbow remains in its existing location; compound bend and lower throat retained. Rectangular opening outlines remain single lines without inset rims. Generic source artwork remains shared across corner variants; IDs and fitting values are distinct. Added a straight connecting edge from the upstream far-side joint to the elbow, above the retained straight reducing edge. User clarification: downstream width = upstream width minus fitting width; the connection edge is not curved. High-resolution raster in SVG.
